messages:
maria: Staging canary failing during release window. Kaniko image extract OOM on multipart layers, several EOFs in the runner logs.
devon: Confirmed. Runner shows `unexpected EOF while reading tar stream` and `no space left on device`. Suspect ephemeral disk eviction.
samir: grabbing kaniko logs now: `kaniko: tar: short read` and `write /tmp: no space left`. Also saw repeated GC churn on runner.
june: deploy-bot auto-held the promo: `promo status: held (artifact extract failures)`. Link posted to canary job.
deploy-bot: Promo held by CI health checks: 3/3 smoke failures. Manual pin allowed for release lead.
ryan: Do we have a last-good image tag to pin to?
maria: Yes, can pin to 1719987654 — that canary passed smoke at 09:12 UTC.
devon: +1 to pin for immediate unblock. Also want a cache-warmup rerun with increased workspace to validate.
ci-orchestrator: Queued job 1724289202: staging-warmup-cache. Will retry kaniko with workspace=30GB and exponential backoff.
samir: I'll run warmup and bump ephemeral runner disk to 30GB for the job. ETA ~6m. I'll collect /var/log/kaniko/*.log and disk metrics.
june: Decision from release lead? Pin now or wait for rerun? Change window ends in 45m.
maria: Official: pin to 1719987654 and manual promote to unblock. Follow up infra fix after promote.
devon: Opening temp PR to bump runner workspace in staging config: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pull/2145. Will add cleanup follow-up.
ci-orchestrator: Warmup job started (job id 1724289202).
samir: Warmup finished: success. kaniko extract completed after workspace bump. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/1724289202/kaniko-warmup.log
samir: Disk metrics snippet uploaded:
"Disk avail before: 5.8GB
Disk avail after warmup: 29GB
Kaniko extract errors disappeared after bump"
june: Proceeding with manual promote. samir, devon, please ensure logs and PR linked in postmortem.
maria: Performing manual promote now.
deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by @june. Promote queued.
ryan: If warmup had failed we'd keep the pin. Since warmup succeeded we'll still keep the pin for safety and schedule fix.
devon: Merged temp runner workspace PR and created infra ticket to adjust retention/cleanup for ephemeral runners.
june: Release notes entry: "Pinned canary to 1719987654 due to staging kaniko image-extract OOM during release window; warmup and runner workspace bump validated; infra follow-up scheduled."
maria: Release window marked green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
